description: Multi-round iterative refinement with peer review at each stage

perspectives.instruction: Propose a solution architecture. Focus on system design, scalability, and maintainability.
Propose an implementation approach. Focus on practical execution, tooling, and development workflow.

supersteps.description: Round 1: Peer review of initial proposals
supersteps.ranking_instructions:
Evaluate proposals based on:
1. Technical soundness and feasibility
2. Completeness of solution
3. Consideration of edge cases and risks
4. Clarity of explanation

Rank from best to worst.

supersteps.description: Round 2: Refine proposals based on peer review

perspectives.instruction: Refine your solution architecture based on the peer review feedback. Address identified weaknesses and incorporate insights from top-ranked proposals.
Refine your implementation approach based on the peer review feedback. Address identified weaknesses and incorporate insights from top-ranked proposals.

map_phase.global_instruction_overlay:
Review the peer rankings and feedback from Round 1. Improve your proposal by:
1. Addressing weaknesses identified by reviewers
2. Incorporating strengths from higher-ranked proposals
3. Adding missing considerations

Previous Round Rankings:
${round1_rankings}

supersteps.description: Round 2: Peer review of refined proposals
supersteps.ranking_instructions:
Evaluate refined proposals based on:
1. Improvement over Round 1 (based on feedback incorporation)
2. Technical soundness and completeness
3. Practical feasibility
4. Overall quality

Rank from best to worst.

supersteps.description: Synthesize final answer from highest-ranked proposals

reduce_phase.chairman_instructions:
Create a comprehensive final solution that:
1. Synthesizes the best elements from the highest-ranked Round 2 proposals
2. Shows clear improvement trajectory from Round 1 to Round 2
3. Addresses all evaluation criteria from both rounds
4. Provides a complete, actionable solution

Round 1 Results:
${round1_rankings}

Round 2 Results (Final):
${round2_rankings}
